claims.value: 24 single-shot DIA runs from human induced pluripotent stem cells across LacZ and three LINE-1 guide conditions.
claims.evidence: RAW names encode condition, biological replicate a-c and duplicate injection R1/R2; PRIDE supplies the DIA and search methods.

limitations: The deposit describes human iPSCs but does not name a specific line or Cellosaurus accession.
The deposited SDRF was deliberately not consulted; this draft is independently reconstructed from record prose and filenames.
